assist_blocks.dataset: Athens 2004 and Beijing 2008 official C73 player box scores
assist_blocks.event_definition: AB (Assist Block) as recorded in the official box score
assist_blocks.test: Pearson chi-square test comparing functional-class distributions of tries and Assist Blocks
assist_blocks.interpretation: Class 0.5 athletes account for 364 of 1,296 recorded Assist Blocks (28.1%). The source does not measure spatial lane creation or prove a causal scoring mechanism.

timeouts.interpretation: The adjusted analysis does not establish that calling a timeout after a scoring run causes improved outcomes. No fixed 3-0 timeout trigger is supported.

female_allowance.dataset: 5,148 active legal lineup stints across six Paralympic tournaments
female_allowance.comparison: Female-inclusive lineup observations versus all-male lineup observations
female_allowance.interpretation: No detectable mean difference was found in this analysis. The result does not establish parity, equivalence, or a causal effect of the allowance.

model_evaluation.cohort: 24 reused 2026 World Championship matches that influenced development
model_evaluation.rank_feature_provenance: Previous-rank field in the official 29-Aug-2026 post-tournament WWR snapshot; no separately dated pre-event snapshot is present in the repository
model_evaluation.interpretation: The reconstructed-rank baseline has the lowest observed Brier score. Paired uncertainty spans zero, so neither model has established superiority. This is not prospective validation.
